text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: Even though you just had a break, you look sleepy?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I was doing a puzzle until morning.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Maybe because it's 1000 pieces,
I just can't seem to finish it...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The art was such a beautiful snowy landscape
that I completely lost myself in it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm looking forward to seeing it finished...

Perhaps because she was absorbed in puzzles all through her days off,
Silence Suzuka seemed to be lacking sleep.
